model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (claude -p, no tools; first run's agent could not read its file)

quantifiers: as many as two squares -> two spaces
only move one square at a time -> proceed one square at a time (only lost)
other: Pawn condition 'if they've never moved before' dropped; replaced with 'without needing to retrace their steps'
Kings: 'in any direction' dropped; new claim 'always maintaining their current location' (contradicts moving)
Queens: diagonal movement dropped; now only horizontal/vertical
Rooks: now move diagonally (original: along ranks or files only)
Knights: 'L' shape and 'take another knight' replaced by 'diagonal leap'
Bishops: 'diagonally any distance' -> 'diagonally in any direction'
pairs.notes: The list marker '2.' and heading 'Initial Movement' are not in the rewrite; I treated the marker as numbering, not a number. Pawn 'never moved' vs 'without needing to retrace' is not a clean negation flip, so negation is false.

other: 'years' of stable public jobs became 'decades' (longer period)
pairs.notes: Otherwise a faithful paraphrase (instituciones públicas -> gubernamentales, empresas públicas -> estatales, empleos -> puestos). 'años'->'décadas' not counted as a number because it is not specific.

quantifiers: local air quality improving -> 'noticeable improvement' (strength added)
encourages cycling activity among residents -> motivates more people to cycle
other: 'motorized routes' -> 'car-based travel' (narrower)
Point 2: 'save time and money on road maintenance' -> 'time and funds freed up for road upkeep' (as congestion drops; roughly same)
Point 3: 'boost neighbourhood health outcomes' -> 'improving community wellness'; 'pedestrians living near bicycle access areas' -> 'walkers in nearby zones'
pairs.notes: Mostly a faithful paraphrase; differences are small. Numbering 1) 2) 3) is the same in both.

quantifiers: very first time -> a few nights (a few added)
other: 'living away from home for the very first time' became 'spending a few nights away from home' (first-time dropped, duration added)
Rhetorical 'Who can blame anyone?' dropped
'daily schedule' dropped
pairs.notes: 'a few nights' is vague, so not listed as a number.

quantifiers: il peggiore degli stomaci infantili -> il più degli stomaci bambini (superlative 'worst' lost)
other: 'coccoeusio' -> 'caldo', 'fuoco infatuoso' -> 'fiamma sottomano', 'dolce' -> 'sapore'; garbled source, meaning unclear
'il peggiore' (worst) no longer stated
pairs.notes: Source is garbled nonsense; only clear differences listed. 'Og' and 'Cuc' kept in both.

other: 'burnered high' -> 'burnered low' (reversed)
'old stone tower' -> 'ancient spire'
coals -> logs; lanterns -> beacons; broke -> shattered
Each night -> Each evening
'many wondered about the weatheredg' -> 'many questioned about the weathered' (object partly lost in both)
'faithfully' -> 'dedicately'; 'coat' -> 'cloak'
pairs.notes: Johnny Longbottom in both. 'decades' not a precise number.

other: Stage title 'Proposal' -> 'Initiative'
'legislator ... or a senator' -> 'official ... or member' (roles changed)
'member of the parliament' -> 'representative of the body'
'proposes a bill' -> 'suggests a measure'
'government business meetings where proposals are debated' -> 'government sessions meetings where ideas are discussed'
'early on' added
pairs.notes: Rewrite is ungrammatical; Australia and MP present in both. Marker '1.' same.

other: 'restrictive notions about car-centric ideologies' -> 'outdated views of car-driven planning' (restrictive -> outdated)
'bike lanes' -> 'bike paths'; 'necessary elements' -> 'a vital part'
Clause about opening opportunities for innovations to emerge dropped; 'a world feasible' -> 'a livable future'
'civic wellbeing goals' -> 'community health'
pairs.notes: Largely faithful paraphrase; differences are nuance.

other: Heading 'Castling' replaced by 'King movement'; verb 'Castle your king' replaced by 'move your king'
'no obstacles' -> 'no pieces block the path'
'pawn still further onto' -> 'advancing your pawn beyond'
pairs.notes: Both texts are incoherent chess rules; 'Castling' treated as a rule term, not a name.

quantifiers: two of the most widely used languages -> languages that dominate the tech field (stronger)
other: 'laid out the groundwork for understanding databases and big data technologies' -> 'introduced me to the principles of' (weaker)
'perform large-scale computations efficiently' -> 'extensive data processing with precision and speed' (precision added)
'solid grasp' -> 'strong foundation'
